commitments.detail: Move the hive to the far east fence, at least 50 feet from the patio, and install a screened barrier before bees become highly active this spring.
Introduce a new queen by May 15th, 2026, to restore the hive to a productive state.
No honey harvest before June 1st, 2026, to allow the new queen and colony to build up sufficiently.
Reserve twelve jars from the first harvest and deliver them by August 20th, 2026.
Keep the hive as part of our shared family activities, with Theo coordinating the relocation, queen introduction, and harvest schedule.
